claims.claim: The U.S. Mint identifies American Eagle silver proof coins as collector versions and publishes their weight, composition, diameter, design, and mint.
The U.S. Mint describes bullion coins as products valued by metal weight and fineness, distinct from numismatic value factors.
The Mint distributes American Eagle bullion coins through authorized purchasers rather than direct public sales.
The U.S. Mint says bullion coin pricing is based on prevailing metal prices plus a premium and can change.
